en.s: The Battle of Fakhkh (Arabic: موقعة فخ‎‎) on 11 June 786 CE was fought between the forces of the Abbasid Caliphate, under Sulayman ibn Abi Ja'far, one of the sons of Caliph al-Mansur, and the supporters of a pro-Alid rebellion in Mecca under Husayn ibn Ali, a grandson of Hasan ibn Ali. The Abbasid army easily crushed the Alid rebellion at the wadi of Fakhkh near Mecca, and Husayn was executed along with many other members of the Alid house. One of the Alids, Idris ibn Abdallah, fled the battlefield to the Maghreb, and established there the Idrisid dynasty.

zh.s: 法赫赫之战（阿拉伯语：موقعة فخ）发生于公元786年6月11日，交战双方是阿拔斯王朝军队和麦加亲阿里派起义者。阿拔斯军队由哈里发曼苏尔之子苏莱曼·伊本·阿比·贾法尔率领；起义者则由哈桑·伊本·阿里的孙子侯赛因·伊本·阿里领导。阿拔斯军队在麦加附近法赫赫干谷轻易镇压了起义，侯赛因和许多阿里派成员遭处决。阿里派成员伊德里斯·伊本·阿卜杜拉逃离战场，前往马格里布，并在那里建立了伊德里斯王朝。

en.s: The Battle of Azaz was fought on 11 June 1125 between King Baldwin II of Jerusalem's crusader forces and allied Muslim forces led by Aq-Sunqur al-Bursuqi, the Seljuq atabeg of Mosul. One of the bloodiest confrontations before the Second Crusade, the battle resulted in a decisive victory for the Crusaders, causing disturbances of power in the Levant and weakening Seljuk domination in the area.

zh.s: 阿扎兹战役于1125年6月11日发生，交战双方是耶路撒冷国王鲍德温二世率领的十字军，以及由摩苏尔塞尔柱阿塔贝格阿克松库尔·布尔苏基率领的穆斯林联军。这是第二次十字军东征前最血腥的冲突之一。十字军取得决定性胜利，改变了黎凡特的势力格局，并削弱了塞尔柱人在当地的统治。

en.s: The Battle of Campaldino was a battle between the Guelphs and Ghibellines on 11 June 1289. Mixed bands of pro-papal Guelf forces of Florence and allies, Pistoia, Lucca, Siena and Prato, all loosely commanded by the paid condottiero Amerigo di Narbona with his own professional following, met a Ghibelline force from Arezzo including the perhaps reluctant bishop, Guglielmino degli Ubertini, in the plain of Campaldino, which leads from Pratovecchio to Poppi, part of the Tuscan countryside along the upper Arno called the Casentino. One of the combatants on the Guelph side was Dante Alighieri, twenty-four years old at the time.

zh.s: 坎帕尔迪诺战役是圭尔夫派与吉伯林派之间的一场战斗，发生于1289年6月11日。教皇派圭尔夫阵营由佛罗伦萨及其盟友皮斯托亚、卢卡、锡耶纳和普拉托的混合部队组成，由受雇的佣兵首领阿梅里戈·迪·纳尔博纳及其职业随从松散指挥。他们在坎帕尔迪诺平原与来自阿雷佐的吉伯林军队交战；后者包括一位可能并不情愿参战的主教古列尔米诺·德利·乌贝尔蒂尼。战场位于托斯卡纳乡间卡森蒂诺地区，从普拉托韦基奥通往波皮。圭尔夫一方的参战者中有但丁·阿利吉耶里，当时他24岁。

en.s: The Battle of Barcelona (June 9–11, 1359) was a naval engagement fought in the coastal region of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, between the navies of the Crowns of Aragon and Castile, during the War of the Two Peters. A number of months beforehand, a large Castilian fleet had been assembled at Seville by order of the King of Castile, Peter I.

zh.s: 巴塞罗那海战发生于1359年6月9日至11日，是两彼得战争期间阿拉贡王室与卡斯蒂利亚王室海军在西班牙加泰罗尼亚巴塞罗那沿海地区进行的一场海战。几个月前，卡斯蒂利亚国王佩德罗一世下令在塞维利亚集结了一支大型舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Jargeau took place on 11–12 June 1429. It was part of the Loire Campaign during the Hundred Years' War, where the forces of Charles VII of France successfully recaptured much of the region, following their victory at the Siege of Orléans. The battle ended in victory for Charles VII and is notable as Joan of Arc's first offensive battle.

zh.s: 雅尔若战役发生于1429年6月11日至12日，是百年战争期间卢瓦尔河战役的一部分。奥尔良围城战获胜后，法国国王查理七世的军队成功收复了该地区大部分领土。雅尔若战役以查理七世获胜告终，也是圣女贞德首次主动发起进攻的战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Sauchieburn was fought on 11 June 1488, at the side of Sauchie Burn, a stream about two miles south of Stirling, Scotland. The battle was fought between the followers of King James III of Scotland and a large group of rebellious Scottish nobles including Alexander Home, 1st Lord Home, nominally led by the king's 15-year-old son, Prince James, Duke of Rothesay.

zh.s: 索奇本战役于1488年6月11日在苏格兰斯特灵以南约两英里的索奇溪畔发生。交战双方是苏格兰国王詹姆斯三世的支持者，以及一群叛乱贵族，其中包括第一代霍姆勋爵亚历山大·霍姆。叛军名义上由国王15岁的儿子、罗撒西公爵詹姆斯王子率领。

en.s: Catherine of Aragon (also spelled Katherine; Spanish: Catalina de Aragón; 16 December 1485 – 7 January 1536) was Queen of England as the first wife of Henry VIII from their marriage on 11 June 1509 until its annulment on 23 May 1533. She had previously been Princess of Wales as the wife of Henry's elder brother Arthur, Prince of Wales for a short time before his death.

zh.t: 阿拉贡的凯瑟琳嫁给英王亨利八世，成为他的第一任妻子
zh.s: 阿拉贡的凯瑟琳（亦拼作Katherine；西班牙语：Catalina de Aragón；1485年12月16日—1536年1月7日）于1509年6月11日嫁给亨利八世，成为英格兰王后，直至1533年5月23日婚姻被废。她此前曾短暂嫁给亨利的哥哥、威尔士亲王亚瑟，并成为威尔士王妃；亚瑟去世后，这段婚姻结束。

en.s: The Nègrepelisse massacre was a massacre committed on 10 and 11 June 1622 by the French Royal Army of King Louis XIII in the Protestant stronghold of Nègrepelisse during the Huguenot rebellions. The taking of the town followed Louis's unsuccessful siege of Montauban. After a short siege the town was captured by assault, and all the inhabitants that the attacking soldiers encountered were put to the sword, without distinction of age or sex, to a total of about 800.

zh.s: 内格勒佩利斯屠杀发生于1622年6月10日至11日，是法国国王路易十三的王家军队在胡格诺派叛乱期间，于新教据点内格勒佩利斯实施的一场屠杀。此前，路易未能攻下蒙托邦。王家军短暂围城后以突袭攻占该镇，并将士兵遇到的居民不分年龄和性别全部杀害，约有800人遇难。

en.s: The Monmouth Rebellion (also known as the Pitchfork Rebellion, Revolt of the West or West Country rebellion) in June 1685 was an attempt to depose James II, who in February had succeeded his brother Charles II as king of England, Scotland and Ireland. Dissident Protestants led by James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth, eldest illegitimate son of Charles II, opposed James largely due to his Catholicism. The failure of Parliamentary efforts to exclude James from the succession in 1681 resulted in the 1683 Rye House Plot, an alleged attempt to assassinate Charles II and James. Monmouth, implicated as a co-conspirator, went into exile in the Dutch Republic. He returned to England when on 11 June 1685, he landed at Lyme Regis in the South West where he had widespread popular support, planning to take control of the area and march on London.

zh.s: 蒙茅斯叛乱又称干草叉叛乱、西部叛乱或西南叛乱，发生于1685年6月，目的是推翻詹姆斯二世。詹姆斯于同年2月继承其兄查理二世，成为英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰国王。由詹姆斯·斯科特（第一代蒙茅斯公爵、查理二世长子但属非婚生子）领导的新教异见者反对詹姆斯，主要因为他信奉天主教。1681年，议会排除詹姆斯继承王位的努力失败，随后出现了1683年的莱伊屋阴谋，据称有人企图刺杀查理二世和詹姆斯。被指为共谋者的蒙茅斯流亡荷兰共和国。1685年6月11日，他在英格兰西南部莱姆里吉斯登陆，当地民众广泛支持他；他计划控制该地区并向伦敦进军。

en.s: The Battle of Hodów took place between the Kingdom of Poland and Budjak Horde forces, fought in June 1694 in the Ruthenian Voivodeship of the Crown of the Kingdom of Poland, near the village of Hodów (now Hodiv in Ternopil Raion, Ternopil Oblast, Ukraine). In Polish sources it is often called the Polish Thermopylae, like the Battle of Wizna.

zh.s: 1694年，波兰王国与布贾克部落联盟军队在鲁塞尼亚省霍多夫村附近交战。波兰资料常称此战为“波兰的温泉关”，与维兹纳战役相提并论。

en.s: The assault on Nijmegen occurred during the War of the Spanish Succession, on 10 and 11 June 1702 involving French troops under the Duke of Boufflers against the small garrison and some citizens of the city of Nijmegen and an Anglo-Dutch army under the Earl of Athlone. In an attempt to save Kaiserswerth from capture by the Allies, Boufflers, through attacking Nijmegen, hoped to force the numerically outnumbered army of Athlone into a battle by luring him away from his strong position.

zh.s: 尼美亨突袭战发生于西班牙王位继承战争期间，时间为1702年6月10日至11日。布弗莱公爵率领法军进攻尼美亨城内人数不多的守军和部分市民，以及阿斯隆伯爵率领的英荷联军。布弗莱希望通过进攻尼美亨，诱使兵力处于劣势的阿斯隆离开坚固阵地迎战，从而解救被盟军围困的凯泽斯韦特。

en.s: The battle of Gangwana was a military engagement fought between the Kingdom of Marwar and a combined army of the Jaipur Kingdom and the Mughal Empire in 1741. The battle resulted in a peace treaty favorable to Marwar and ended a period of Jaipur domination in what is now present day Rajasthan.

zh.s: 1741年，马尔瓦尔王国与斋浦尔王国和莫卧儿帝国联军交战。战役以马尔瓦尔有利的和平条约告终，也结束了斋浦尔对今印度拉贾斯坦邦部分地区的统治。

en.s: The coronation of Louis XVI as King of France and Navarre took place in Reims Cathedral on 11 June 1775, which fell on Trinity Sunday. Louis XVI had come to the throne the previous year in succession to his grandfather Louis XV who had reigned for 59 years. It was the first coronation since 1722 and only the second since 1654 due to the longevity of the two previous monarchs, Louis XIV and Louis XV.

zh.s: 路易十六于1775年6月11日在兰斯主教座堂加冕为法国和纳瓦拉国王，当天是三一主日。路易十六于前一年继承其祖父路易十五的王位；路易十五在位59年。由于路易十四和路易十五两位前任君主在位时间很长，这是自1722年以来的首次加冕礼，也是1654年以来的第二次加冕礼。

en.s: The Battle of Machias (June 11–12, 1775) was an early naval engagement of the American Revolutionary War, also known as the Battle of the Margaretta, fought around the port of Machias, Maine. Following the outbreak of the war, British authorities enlisted Loyalist merchant Ichabod Jones to supply the troops who were under the Siege of Boston.

zh.s: 马基亚斯海战（又称“玛格丽特号之战”）发生于1775年6月11日至12日，是美国独立战争早期的一场海战，战场位于缅因州马基亚斯港附近。战争爆发后，英国当局征用效忠派商人伊卡博德·琼斯，为正在波士顿围城中的部队提供物资。

en.s: The Second Continental Congress (1775–1781) was the meeting of delegates from the Thirteen Colonies that united in support of the American Revolution and Revolutionary War, which established American independence from Great Britain. The Congress constituted a new federation that it first named the United Colonies of North America, and in 1776, renamed the United States of America.
en.n: American Revolution: The Second Continental Congress appoints Thomas Jefferson, John Adams, Benjamin Franklin, Roger Sherman, and Robert R. Livingston to the Committee of Five to draft a declaration of independence.

zh.t: 第二届大陆会议任命“五人委员会”起草《独立宣言》
zh.s: 第二届大陆会议由来自13个殖民地的代表组成，支持美国革命和独立战争，推动美国脱离英国独立。会议先将新的联邦命名为“北美联合殖民地”，后于1776年改名为“美利坚合众国”。
zh.n: 美国革命：第二届大陆会议任命托马斯·杰斐逊、约翰·亚当斯、本杰明·富兰克林、罗杰·谢尔曼和罗伯特·R·利文斯顿组成“五人委员会”，起草《独立宣言》。

en.s: The Battle of Mir was a battle between Poland–Lithuania and the Russian Empire during the War of 1792. It took place in the town of Mir, now in Belarus, on June 11, 1792. The battle between Russian veterans from Russia's recent wars with the Ottomans and Sweden and an inexperienced Lithuanian force ended in a Russian victory.

zh.s: 米尔战役是1792年战争期间波兰立陶宛联邦与俄罗斯帝国之间的一场战斗。战斗于1792年6月11日在现属白俄罗斯的米尔镇发生。交战双方是曾参加俄罗斯近期对奥斯曼帝国和瑞典战争的老兵，以及一支缺乏经验的立陶宛部队，最终俄军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Saumur was a battle during the Vendee Revolt. It occurred in the town of Saumur on 11 June 1793. As at the battle of Thouars, the Republican prisoners were released after swearing not to fight again in the Vendée and having had their hair shaved off so they could be recognised lest they went back on their word and were recaptured. In the prison at Saumur, the Vendéens found general Pierre Quétineau who had been taken prisoner after his defeat at Thouars.

zh.s: 索米尔战役是旺代叛乱期间的一场战斗，于1793年6月11日在索米尔镇发生。与图阿尔战役后一样，共和派俘虏获释前宣誓不再参加旺代战争，并被剃去头发，以便违背誓言、再次被俘时能够认出他们。在索米尔监狱里，旺代军找到了将军皮埃尔·凯蒂诺；他此前在图阿尔战败后被俘。

en.s: The Great Fire of 1805 occurred on June 11, 1805, in Detroit, which was then part of the Michigan Territory of the United States. The fire destroyed the remaining vestiges of the old Fort Ponchartrain and a vast number of buildings in its vicinity. Fort Lernoult and a warehouse on the river were the only structures in Detroit that survived the conflagration.

zh.s: 1805年6月11日，美国密歇根领地底特律发生大火。大火烧毁了旧庞恰特雷恩堡遗址及附近大量建筑。底特律只有勒努尔堡和河边一座仓库在大火中幸存。

en.s: In the Battle of Maguilla (11 June 1812) a British cavalry brigade led by Major General John Slade attacked a similar-sized French cavalry brigade commanded by General of Brigade Charles Lallemand. The British dragoons scored an initial success, routing the French dragoons and capturing a number of them. The British troopers recklessly galloped after their foes, losing all order.

zh.s: 马吉利亚战役发生于1812年6月11日。约翰·斯莱德少将率领的一支英军骑兵旅袭击了查尔斯·拉勒芒准将指挥、规模相近的法军骑兵旅。英军龙骑兵起初得手，击溃法军龙骑兵并俘获多人。随后英军骑兵鲁莽地追击敌军，队形因此散乱。

en.s: In the siege of Tarragona (3–11 June 1813), an overwhelming Anglo-Allied force commanded by Lieutenant General John Murray, 8th Baronet, failed to capture the Spanish port of Tarragona from a small Franco-Italian garrison led by General of Brigade Antoine Marc Augustin Bertoletti. Murray was subsequently removed from command for his indecisive and contradictory leadership.

en.s: Partial legislative elections were held in Belgium on 11 June 1839. In the Senate elections Catholics won 27 seats and Liberals 12. Voter turnout was 66.4%, although only 23,661 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, Chamber elections were only held in four out of the nine provinces: East Flanders, Hainaut, Liège and Limburg. Thus, 47 of the 98 Chamber seats were up for election.

zh.s: 比利时于1839年6月11日举行部分议会选举。参议院选举中，天主教党赢得27席，自由党赢得12席。投票率为66.4%，但只有23,661人符合投票资格。按照轮替制度，众议院选举只在九个省中的四个省举行：东佛兰德省、埃诺省、列日省和林堡省。因此，众议院98个席位中有47席参与改选。

en.s: The Battle of Trevilian Station (also called Trevilians) was fought on June 11–12, 1864, in Union Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's Overland Campaign against Confederate Gen. Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia. Union cavalry under Maj. Gen. Philip Sheridan fought against Confederate cavalry under Maj. Gens. Wade Hampton and Fitzhugh Lee in the bloodiest and largest all-cavalry battle of the war. Sheridan's objectives for his raid were to destroy stretches of the Virginia Central Railroad, provide a diversion that would occupy Confederate cavalry from understanding Grant's planned crossing of the James River, and to link up with the army of Maj.

en.s: The Battle of Riachuelo (or Battle of the Riachuelo) was a large and decisive naval battle of the Paraguayan War between Paraguay and the Empire of Brazil. By late 1864, Paraguay had scored a series of victories in the war, but on 11 June 1865, its naval defeat by the Brazilians on the Paraná River began to turn the tide in favor of the allies.

zh.s: 里亚丘埃洛海战（又称里亚丘埃洛河海战）是巴拉圭战争期间巴拉圭与巴西帝国之间一场规模较大、影响重大的海战。1864年末，巴拉圭在战争中接连获胜；但1865年6月11日，巴西海军在巴拉那河击败巴拉圭海军，战局从此开始向盟军一方倾斜。

en.s: The Retreat from Laguna, also called the Battle of Laguna (A Retirada da Laguna [1]), was a decisive military engagement fought between the forces of Paraguay and Brazil. After the invasion of the then province of Mato Grosso (nowadays Mato Grosso do Sul) by the forces of the Paraguayan Army in December 1864, starting the Triple Alliance War (together with the capture of the steamer Marquês de Olinda), one of the first Brazilian moves was to send a military land contingent to fight the invaders in Mato Grosso.

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 11 June 1872. In the elections for the Chamber of Representatives the result was a victory for the Catholic Party, which won 71 of the 124 seats. Voter turnout was 55.5%, although only 54,933 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections were only held in five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders.

zh.s: 比利时于1872年6月11日举行部分大选。在众议院选举中，天主教党获胜，赢得124个席位中的71席。投票率为55.5%，但只有54,933人符合投票资格。按照轮替制度，选举只在九个省中的五个省举行：安特卫普省、布拉班特省、卢森堡省、那慕尔省和西佛兰德省。

en.s: The 1888 Hong Kong Sanitary Board election was held on 11 June 1888 for the two unofficial seats in the Sanitary Board of Hong Kong. Sanitary Board was set up in 1883 to supervise and control the practical sanitation of the colony. As its work involved interference with the private affairs of residents it was unpopular with property owners and with the Chinese generally.

zh.s: 1888年香港洁净局选举于1888年6月11日举行，选出洁净局的两个非官守议席。洁净局于1883年成立，负责监督和管理殖民地的实际卫生事务。由于其工作涉及干预居民私生活，因此不受业主和华人普遍欢迎。

en.t: Salvation Army formally establishes the Limelight Department
en.s: The Salvation Army formally established its Limelight Department in Melbourne, Australia, on June 11, 1892. Led by Joseph Henry Perry, it initially made and projected photographic lantern slides for the Army's public presentations. The department later took up motion pictures and became an early Australian film producer; it was not yet a film studio on its 1892 founding day.
en.n: June 11 marks formal establishment of the slide-presentation department. Its film work began later in the 1890s.

zh.t: 救世军正式成立聚光灯部
zh.s: 1892年6月11日，救世军在澳大利亚墨尔本正式成立“聚光灯部”，由约瑟夫·亨利·佩里负责。它起初制作和放映摄影幻灯片，供救世军公开活动使用；到19世纪90年代后期才开始拍电影，后来成为澳大利亚早期的电影制作机构。成立当天它还不是电影制片厂。
zh.n: 6月11日是幻灯片放映部门正式成立的日期。电影制作是19世纪90年代后期才开展的业务。

en.s: The 1895 Canterbury colonial by-election was held on 11 June 1895 to elect the member for Canterbury in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly, following the resignation of Free Trade Party MP Varney Parkes. Under the Constitution of New South Wales, if a sitting member "becomes bankrupt or takes the benefit of any law for the relief of bankrupt or insolvent debtors" they are disqualified from sitting in parliament.

zh.t: 1895年新南威尔士坎特伯雷殖民地补选
zh.s: 1895年坎特伯雷殖民地补选于1895年6月11日举行，选出新南威尔士州坎特伯雷选区的立法议会议员。自由贸易党议员瓦尼·帕克斯辞职后，该席位出现空缺。根据《新南威尔士州宪法》，在任议员“破产或依据任何法律获得破产或无力偿债债务人的救济”后，将失去议会席位资格。

en.t: A group of Serbian officers storms the royal palace and assassinates King Alexander I of Serbia and his wife, Queen Draga
en.s: The May Coup (Serbian: Мајски преврат, romanized: Majski prevrat) was a coup d'état in the Kingdom of Serbia which resulted in the assassination of King Alexander I and his consort, Queen Draga, inside the Stari Dvor in Belgrade on the night of 10–11 June [O.S. 28–29 May] 1903. This act resulted in the extinction of the Obrenović dynasty that had ruled Serbia since the mid-19th century.

zh.t: 塞尔维亚军官冲入王宫并刺杀亚历山大一世和德拉加王后
zh.s: 五月政变（塞尔维亚语：Маjски преврат，拉丁转写：Majski prevrat）是塞尔维亚王国的一场政变。1903年6月10日至11日夜间，塞尔维亚军官在贝尔格莱德的旧王宫内刺杀了国王亚历山大一世及其妻子德拉加王后（按儒略历为5月28日至29日）。这次政变终结了自19世纪中叶起统治塞尔维亚的奥布雷诺维奇王朝。

en.s: The 1905 German football championship final decided the winner of the 1905 German football championship, the 2nd edition of the German football championship, a knockout football cup competition contested by the regional league winners to determine the national champions. The match was played on 11 June 1905 at the Weidenpescher Park in Cologne. Union 92 Berlin won the match 2–0 against Karlsruher FV for their 1st German title.

zh.s: 1905年德国足球锦标赛决赛决出了该年度德国足球锦标赛冠军。这是德国足球锦标赛的第二届赛事，为一项由各地区联赛冠军参加的淘汰赛制杯赛，旨在决出全国冠军。决赛于1905年6月11日在科隆的魏登佩施公园球场举行。柏林联合92队以2比0击败卡尔斯鲁厄足球俱乐部，首次夺冠。

en.s: The War of 1907 (Spanish: Guerra de 1907) was a conflict fought between El Salvador and an alliance between Honduras, Nicaragua, Salvadoran exiles, and American filibusters. The invasion of El Salvador on 11 June 1907 resulted in a quick military victory for El Salvador as invading forces withdrew by the end of the day.

zh.s: 1907年战争（西班牙语：Guerra de 1907）是萨尔瓦多与一个联军之间的冲突。联军成员包括洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、萨尔瓦多流亡者和美国雇佣兵。1907年6月11日，联军入侵萨尔瓦多，但当天撤军，萨尔瓦多迅速取得军事胜利。

en.s: The Mamornița border clash was an incursion of Russian forces into Romanian territory during the Brusilov Offensive in World War I. As Romania was neutral at the time, the Russian forces left Romanian territory soon afterwards.

en.t: Alexander becomes king of Greece after Constantine I yields the throne
en.s: Alexander became king of Greece on June 11, 1917, after Allied powers pressed his father, Constantine I, to leave the throne during World War I. Alexander took the constitutional oath that afternoon at the Royal Palace in Athens. Constantine and the crown prince left the country; Alexander, Constantine's second son, remained as king.
en.n: June 11 is Alexander's accession and oath date in the Gregorian calendar; the Allied demand and Constantine's departure belong to a wider sequence.

zh.t: 亚历山大继任希腊国王
zh.s: 1917年6月11日，第一次世界大战期间，协约国向希腊国王康斯坦丁一世施压，要求他离开王位。康斯坦丁指定次子亚历山大继任。亚历山大当天下午在雅典王宫宣誓遵守宪法；康斯坦丁和王储随后离开希腊。
zh.n: 公历6月11日是亚历山大继位并宣誓的日期。协约国施压及康斯坦丁离境属于前后相连的一系列事件。

en.s: The Abkhazia operation was a successful military operation by the Democratic Republic of Georgia. Its aim was to regain the control over Abkhazia from Abkhazian Bolsheviks.

zh.s: 1920年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛是第33届全爱尔兰决赛，也是该届锦标赛的冠军决定赛。该赛事是爱尔兰顶级郡际盖尔式足球锦标赛。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 11 June 1932 to elect the 62 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The election saw the first-term Country and Progressive National Party government led by Arthur Edward Moore facing reelection and was held in the midst of the Great Depression. Labor had previously held office from 1915 until 1929.

en.s: The 1932 New South Wales state election was held on 11 June 1932. This election was for all of the 90 seats in the 30th New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in single member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting (Instant-runoff voting). The election resulted in a landslide victory for the UAP/Country Party coalition of Bertram Stevens, which won an 18-seat majority in the legislature.

en.s: The 1935–36 Coppa Italia final was a single match played on 11 June 1936, between Torino and Alessandria at the Stadio Luigi Ferraris in Genoa. It was the first Coppa Italia final since 1922; in fact this tournament was not organized in the 1923–1925 and 1928–1935 periods; 1926–27 edition was interrupted after few rounds. Both Torino and Alessandria were playing in Serie A at that time.

zh.s: 1935–36赛季意大利杯决赛于1936年6月11日在热那亚的路易吉·费拉里斯球场举行，是都灵队与亚历山德里亚队之间的一场单场决赛。这是自1922年以来的首场意大利杯决赛。该赛事在1923至1925年和1928至1935年间没有举办；1926–27赛季的赛事则在开赛数轮后中断。当时都灵和亚历山德里亚都在意甲联赛参赛。

en.s: The Battle of Wuhan (traditional Chinese: 武漢會戰; simplified Chinese: 武汉会战; Japanese: 武漢作戦 (ぶかんさくせん)), popularly known to the Chinese as the Defense of Wuhan (traditional Chinese: 武漢保衛戰; simplified Chinese: 武汉保卫战), and to the Japanese as the Capture of Wuhan, was the largest, longest, and bloodiest battle of the Second Sino-Japanese War. Engagements took place across vast areas of Anhui, Henan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and Hubei provinces over four and a half months.

zh.s: 武汉会战（繁体中文：武漢會戰；日语：武漢作戦）是中国抗日战争中规模最大、历时最长、伤亡最惨重的一场战役。中国方面称之为“武汉保卫战”，日本方面称为“武汉攻略战”。战斗持续四个半月，战场遍及安徽、河南、江西、浙江和湖北等省。

en.s: Operation Corkscrew was the code name for the Allied invasion of the Italian island of Pantelleria (between Sicily and Tunisia) on 11 June 1943, prior to the Allied invasion of Sicily during the Second World War. There had been an early plan to occupy the island in late 1940 (Operation Workshop), but this was aborted when the Luftwaffe strengthened the Axis air threat in the region. The Allied focus returned to Pantelleria in early 1943. The radar installations and airfield on the island were seen as a real threat to the planned invasion of Sicily (codenamed Operation Husky).

zh.s: 开瓶器行动是盟军入侵意大利潘泰莱里亚岛的代号。该岛位于西西里岛和突尼斯之间，入侵发生于1943年6月11日，为随后盟军入侵西西里岛做准备。盟军曾计划于1940年末占领该岛，代号“工坊行动”，但轴心国空中威胁因德国空军加强部署而上升，计划因此取消。1943年初，盟军重新将注意力转向潘泰莱里亚岛。岛上的雷达设施和机场被视为对计划中西西里岛入侵行动（代号“哈士奇行动”）的实际威胁。

en.s: The Battle of Le Mesnil-Patry during the Second World War was the last attack by a Canadian armoured battle group in Normandy in June 1944. The Queen's Own Rifles of Canada of the 8th Canadian Infantry Brigade of the 3rd Canadian Division, supported by the 6th Armoured Regiment (1st Hussars) of the 2nd Canadian Armoured Brigade attacked the village of Le Mesnil-Patry to advance southwards towards the higher ground of Hill 107 west of Cheux.

zh.s: 勒梅尼尔帕特里战役发生于1944年6月第二次世界大战期间，是诺曼底战役中加拿大装甲战斗群的最后一次进攻。加拿大第3步兵师第8旅的加拿大女王亲兵团在第2加拿大装甲旅第6装甲团（第一骠骑兵团）支援下，进攻勒梅尼尔帕特里村，目标是向南推进，夺取切克斯以西的107高地。

en.s: The Canadian federal election of 1945 was the 20th general election in Canadian history. It was held June 11, 1945 to elect members of the Canadian House of Commons of the 20th Parliament of Canada. Prime Minister William Lyon Mackenzie King's Liberal government was re-elected to its third consecutive government, although this time with a minority government as the Liberals fell 5 seats short of a majority. Although the election officially resulted in a minority government, the election of eight "Independent Liberal" MPs, most of whom did not run as official Liberals because of their opposition to conscription (see Conscription Crisis of 1944), gave the King government an effective working majority in parliament.

zh.s: 1945年加拿大联邦大选是加拿大历史上的第20次大选，于1945年6月11日举行，选出加拿大第20届议会的下议院议员。总理威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐·金领导的自由党政府成功连任，连续第三次组阁，但这次只组成少数政府，自由党距离多数席位还差5席。虽然选举正式产生的是少数政府，但有8名“独立自由党”议员当选，其中大多数人因反对征兵而未以正式自由党候选人身份参选（参见1944年征兵危机），这让金政府在议会实际拥有可运作的多数。

en.t: 7th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
en.s: The 7th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was convened from April 23 to June 11, 1945, in Yan'an, Shaanxi. It took place near the end of the Second Sino-Japanese War during a period of uneasy truce between the Kuomintang and Communist parties, with each maintaining their headquarters in different regions of China. It was preceded by the 6th National Congress and followed by the 8th National Congress.

zh.t: 中国共产党第七次全国代表大会
zh.s: 中国共产党第七次全国代表大会于1945年4月23日至6月11日在陕西延安举行。当时第二次中日战争接近尾声，国民党和共产党之间维持着紧张的停战状态，双方总部设在中国不同地区。此前举行的是第六次全国代表大会，此后召开的是第八次全国代表大会。

en.s: The Stand in the Schoolhouse Door took place at Foster Auditorium at the University of Alabama on June 11, 1963. In a symbolic attempt to keep his inaugural promise of "segregation now, segregation tomorrow, segregation forever" and stop the desegregation of schools, George Wallace, the Democratic governor of Alabama, stood at the door of the auditorium as if to block the way of the two African American students attempting to enter: Vivian Malone and James Hood.

zh.s: 校舍门前的对峙于1963年6月11日在阿拉巴马大学福斯特礼堂发生。阿拉巴马州民主党州长乔治·华莱士曾承诺“现在实行种族隔离，明天实行种族隔离，永远实行种族隔离”。为兑现这一承诺并阻止学校废除种族隔离，他站在礼堂门口，象征性地挡住两名试图进入的非裔美国学生薇薇安·马隆和詹姆斯·胡德。

en.s: The Cologne school massacre was a mass murder that occurred at the Catholic elementary school (German: katholische Volksschule) located in the suburb of Volkhoven in Cologne, North Rhine-Westphalia, West Germany, on 11 June 1964. The perpetrator, Walter Seifert, also known as "Der Feuerteufel von Volkhoven" ("Firedevil of Volkhoven"), attacked the people at the school with a home-made flamethrower and a spear, killing eight pupils and two teachers, and wounding twenty-two others.

zh.s: 科隆校园屠杀案发生于1964年6月11日，地点是西德北莱茵-威斯特法伦州科隆市沃尔霍芬郊区的一所天主教小学（德语：katholische Volksschule）。行凶者瓦尔特·赛弗特又被称为“沃尔霍芬纵火恶魔”（Der Feuerteufel von Volkhoven）。他用自制火焰喷射器和长矛袭击学校人员，杀害8名学生和2名教师，另有22人受伤。

en.s: The Occupation of Alcatraz (November 20, 1969 – June 11, 1971) was a 19-month long occupation of Alcatraz Island and its prison complex, then classified as abandoned surplus federal land, by 89 American Indians and their supporters. The occupation was led by Richard Oakes, LaNada Means, and others, while John Trudell served as spokesman. The group lived on the island together until the occupation was forcibly ended by the U.S. government.

en.s: The Irish general election of 1981 was held on 11 June 1981, three weeks after the dissolution of the Dáil on 21 May. The newly elected 166 members of the 22nd Dáil assembled at Leinster House on 30 June when a new Taoiseach and government were appointed. The general election took place in 41 parliamentary constituencies throughout Ireland for 166 seats in the lower house of parliament, Dáil Éireann. The number of seats in the Dáil was increased by 18 from 148 to 166.

en.s: The Battle of Mount Kent was a series of engagements during the Falklands War, primarily between British and Argentine special forces. en.s: MCA Records released John Williams's soundtrack album for E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial on June 11, 1982, the same day the film opened in U.S. theaters. Williams composed and conducted the music. The original album presented concert arrangements of themes from the film rather than a track-by-track reproduction of the score as heard on screen.

en.s: The United Kingdom general election of 1987 was held on 11 June 1987, to elect 650 members to the British House of Commons. The election was the third consecutive election victory for the Conservative Party under the leadership of Margaret Thatcher, who became the first Prime Minister since the 2nd Earl of Liverpool in 1820 to lead a party into three successive election victories. The Conservatives ran a campaign focusing on lower taxes, a strong economy and strong defence. They also emphasised that unemployment had fallen below 3 million for the first time since 1981, and inflation was standing at 4%, its lowest level for some 20 years.

zh.s: 英国大选于1987年6月11日举行，选出650名下议院议员。这是玛格丽特·撒切尔领导的保守党连续第三次赢得大选。自1820年第二代利物浦伯爵以来，撒切尔是首位带领政党连续三次获胜的首相。保守党的竞选重点是减税、强劲的经济和国防实力。该党还强调，失业人数自1981年以来首次降至300万以下，通胀率为4%，是近20年来的最低水平。

en.t: 1987 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 11 June 1987, the 1987 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 650 members of the House of Commons, including the 17 Northern Ireland seats. 1,090,389 people were eligible to vote, up 40,253 from the 1983 general election. Nevertheless, the turnout was down 5.9 percentage points from the last general election. The Conservative Party led by Margaret Thatcher as prime minister won another term in government.

en.t: 1987 United Kingdom general election in England
en.s: On Thursday 11 June 1987, the 1987 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 650 members of the House of Commons, with 523 constituencies being in England. The Conservative Party won an overall majority of English seats for the third successive election and enough seats to seal a UK-wide majority already within England's borders. 326 was the UK-wide threshold and the Conservatives won 358 in the English constituencies.

en.s: The 2004 Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) coup attempt was a foiled coup d'état against the UN-backed Transitional Government, led by renegade members of the presidential guard, including Major Eric Lenge. At 2:40 AM local time on June 11, rebel forces briefly seized control of state broadcast stations and announced the suspension of the country's transitional institutions with Major Lenge assuming control himself.

zh.t: 2004年刚果民主共和国政变未遂
zh.s: 2004年刚果民主共和国政变未遂事件是一次针对联合国支持的过渡政府的政变，政变由总统卫队中的叛变成员发动，主要人物包括埃里克·伦格少校。当地时间6月11日凌晨2时40分，叛军一度控制国家广播电台，并宣布暂停国家过渡机构，由伦格少校接管政权。

en.s: The 2005 Copa del Rey final was the 103rd final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The match was played at Vicente Calderón in Madrid, on 11 June 2005. Real Betis beat Osasuna 2–1 in extra time, to win the tournament for the second time.

zh.s: 2005年西班牙国王杯决赛是西班牙杯赛国王杯的第103场决赛，于2005年6月11日在马德里的卡尔德隆球场举行。皇家贝蒂斯在加时赛中以2比1击败奥萨苏纳，第二次夺得该项赛事冠军。

en.s: ECW One Night Stand (2006) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was held on June 11, 2006, at the Hammerstein Ballroom in New York, New York. The main event was John Cena versus Rob Van Dam for the WWE Championship, which Van Dam won by pinfall after performing a Five Star Frog Splash following interference from Edge. The predominant match on the undercard was Rey Mysterio versus Sabu for the World Heavyweight Championship, which ended in a no contest after Sabu executed a Triple Jump DDT on Mysterio through a table on to the floor rendering both men kayfabe unable to wrestle, as a result, Mysterio retained the title.

zh.s: ECW《一夜摊牌》（2006年）是一场由世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2006年6月11日在纽约市哈默斯坦舞厅举行。主赛是约翰·塞纳对阵罗布·范·达姆争夺WWE冠军；边缘干扰后，范·达姆施展五星蛙式飞扑压制对手，赢得比赛。副赛中的焦点对决是雷·密斯特里奥对阵萨布，争夺世界重量级冠军。萨布对密斯特里奥施展三段跳DDT，将他撞穿桌子摔到场外地板上；按照剧情设定，两人因此都无法继续比赛，比赛以无结果收场，密斯特里奥保住冠军。

en.t: Empty Ngong Ping cable car falls during a brake test
en.s: On June 11, 2007, an empty cabin fell from Hong Kong’s Ngong Ping cable car system during a brake test conducted after passenger services had ended. Nobody was injured. The incident led to the suspension of public services and a government investigation.
en.n: The fall occurred on June 11; the investigation findings were announced in September.

zh.t: 昂坪缆车空车厢在制动测试中坠落
zh.s: 2007年6月11日，香港昂坪缆车在当天载客服务结束后进行制动测试，一节空车厢从缆索坠落，没有造成人员受伤。事故后，缆车暂停向公众开放，政府展开调查。
zh.n: 事故发生在6月11日，调查结果于9月公布。

en.t: Fermi gamma-ray space telescope launches from Cape Canaveral
en.s: On June 11, 2008, the space telescope now known as Fermi launched from Cape Canaveral, Florida, aboard a Delta II rocket. Originally called the Gamma-ray Large Area Space Telescope, it was sent into orbit to study high-energy sources such as gamma-ray bursts and active galaxies.
en.n: This records the launch; the telescope received the name Fermi later in 2008.

zh.t: 费米伽马射线太空望远镜从卡纳维拉尔角发射
zh.s: 2008年6月11日，后来被命名为费米的太空望远镜搭乘德尔塔II型火箭，从美国佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。它当时名为伽马射线大面积太空望远镜，用于在轨观测伽马射线暴、活动星系等高能天体。
zh.n: 此条记录发射日期，费米这一名称是在2008年稍后采用的。

en.s: The FIFA World Cup is an international association football competition among the senior men's national teams of the members of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA), the sport's global governing body. The tournament has been held every four years since the inaugural tournament in 1930, with the exception of 1942 and 1946 during and shortly after World War II.
en.n: The first FIFA World Cup held on African soil kicks off in South Africa.

zh.t: 南非举行首届在非洲本土举办的国际足联世界杯
zh.s: 国际足联世界杯是国际足联成员国成年男子国家队参加的国际足球赛事。首届赛事于1930年举行，此后每四年举办一次；1942年和1946年因第二次世界大战及战后影响而停办。
zh.n: 首届在非洲本土举办的国际足联世界杯在南非开幕。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in Albania on 30 May, 4, 8 and 11 June 2012. The first through third rounds of voting were inconclusive. The fourth round resulted in the incumbent party's member Bujar Nishani being elected as president.

en.s: On 11 June 2012, two moderate earthquakes struck northern Afghanistan, causing a large landslide. The landslide buried the town of Sayi Hazara, trapping 71 people. After four days of digging, only five bodies were recovered and the search was called off. Overall, 75 people were killed and 13 others were injured.

en.s: The 2013 Tulsa mayoral election was held on June 11, 2013 to elect the mayor of Tulsa, Oklahoma. No candidate received a majority vote in the primary elections, and the top two finishers advanced to a runoff election on November 12, 2013. Incumbent mayor Dewey F. Bartlett Jr. was re-elected to a second term after facing former mayor Kathy Taylor.

zh.s: 2013年塔尔萨市长选举于2013年6月11日举行，以选出俄克拉荷马州塔尔萨市市长。初选中没有候选人获得多数票，得票最高的两名候选人进入2013年11月12日的第二轮投票。时任市长小杜威·F·巴特利特击败前市长凯西·泰勒，成功连任第二届。

en.s: The 2016 Rajya Sabha elections were held as part of a routine six-year cycle among certain of the State Legislatures in India on March 14 and June 11, 2016, to elect 13 and 57 of its 245 members, of which the states through their legislators elect 233, and the remaining 12 are appointed by the President.

zh.s: 2016年印度联邦院选举是部分邦议会按常规六年周期举行的选举，投票日期为2016年3月14日和6月11日，选出联邦院245名议员中的13名和57名。各邦议员选出其中233名，其余12名由总统任命。

en.s: The National Coalition Party leadership election, 2016 was held in Lappeenranta, Finland on 11 June 2016, to elect the chair of the National Coalition Party. In the election, Alexander Stubb, the incumbent party chair and Minister of Finance, was defeated by Petteri Orpo, the Minister of the Interior. Elina Lepomäki, a Member of the Parliament, finished third. After the leadership election, Orpo took Stubb's post as the Minister of Finance.

zh.s: 民族联合党党魁选举于2016年6月11日在芬兰拉彭兰塔举行，选出该党主席。时任党主席兼财政部长亚历山大·斯图布败给内政部长佩特里·奥尔波。议员埃利娜·莱波迈基排名第三。党魁选举结束后，奥尔波接替斯图布出任财政部长。

zh.s: 2017年国际足联U-20世界杯决赛于2017年6月11日在韩国水原的水原世界杯体育场举行，决出该届赛事冠军。委内瑞拉和英格兰进入决赛，英格兰以1比0获胜，首次夺得冠军。

zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：刘易斯对阵亨特（又称UFC格斗之夜110）是一场由终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）主办的综合格斗赛事，于2017年6月11日在新西兰奥克兰的斯帕克体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2017 Netball Superleague Grand Final featured Wasps and Loughborough Lightning. Wasps won the Netball Superleague title in their debut season, beating Lightning 55–51 in the grand final. Wasps led by one goal at the start of the final quarter, having dominated Lightning in the mid-court. Wasps centre, Bongiwe Msomi, was subsequently named player of the match. Wasps attacking combination of Rachel Dunn and Natalie Haythornthwaite proved too strong for Lightning.

zh.t: 2017年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2017年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛由黄蜂队对阵拉夫堡闪电队。黄蜂队在参加联赛的首个赛季便夺冠，以55比51击败闪电队。进入末节时，黄蜂队领先1分，并在中场区域压制了闪电队。黄蜂队中锋邦吉韦·姆索米随后获选为全场最佳球员。黄蜂队由蕾切尔·邓恩和娜塔莉·海索恩思韦特组成的进攻搭档表现更胜一筹。

en.s: The 2017 French Open was a tennis tournament played on outdoor clay courts. It was the 116th edition of the French Open and the second Grand Slam event of the year. It took place at the Stade Roland Garros from 28 May to 11 June and consisted of events for players in singles, doubles and mixed doubles play. Junior and wheelchair players also took part in singles and doubles events.

en.t: United States v Thailand (2019 FIFA Women's World Cup)
en.s: United States v Thailand was the first game to be played in Group F of the group stage of the 2019 FIFA Women's World Cup. The game was played in the Stade Auguste-Delaune in Reims, France, on June 11, 2019, between the women's national football (soccer) teams of the United States and Thailand. The United States won the match 13–0, making it the biggest ever victory in the FIFA Women's World Cup.

zh.t: 美国对泰国（2019年女足世界杯）
zh.s: 美国对泰国是2019年国际足联女足世界杯F组小组赛的首场比赛，于2019年6月11日在法国兰斯的奥古斯特·德洛纳体育场举行，参赛双方为美国和泰国女子足球国家队。美国队以13比0获胜，创下女足世界杯史上最大比分胜利。

en.s: The Central Libya offensive, officially known as Operation Paths to Victory, was a military offensive in Libya launched by the forces of the Government of National Accord, to take the city of Sirte and Al Jufra Airbase from the House of Representatives backed by the Libyan National Army. The city of Sirte is considered strategically important because of its close position to oil facilities, which give it control over Libya's oil and gas shipping ports.

en.s: The People Power Party held a leadership election on 11 June 2021. The party leadership was vacant since 15 April 2020 following the resignation of Hwang Kyo-ahn on that day due to the party's crushing defeat in the 2020 election. Until the leadership election is held, there were 4 acting party presidents — Shim Jae-chul, Joo Ho-young, Kim Chong-in and Kim Gi-hyeon; all except Kim Chong-in were the parliamentary leaders.

zh.s: 国民力量党于2021年6月11日举行党魁选举。此前党魁职位一直空缺：黄教安因该党在2020年选举中惨败，于2020年4月15日辞职。党魁选举举行前，沈在哲、朱豪英、金钟仁和金起炫四人先后担任代理党首；除金钟仁外，他们都曾任国会议员党团领袖。

en.s: Operation Alula Aba Nega (Tigrinya: ወፍሪ አሉላ አባ ነጋ), commonly shortened to Operation Alula (Tigrinya: ወፍሪ አሉላ), was a counter-offensive during the Tigray War by the Tigray Defense Forces against the Ethiopian military and its allies in Tigray. The operation was named after Ethiopian general Ras Alula Aba Nega, who was of Tigrayan descent. The offensive was launched on 11 June 2021 and recaptured vast swaths of territory across central and eastern Tigray, including the regional capital of Mekelle.

zh.s: 阿卢拉·阿巴·内加行动（提格利尼亚语：ወፍሪ አሉላ አባ ነጋ），简称阿卢拉行动，是提格雷战争期间提格雷国防军对埃塞俄比亚军方及其盟友发动的一次反攻。行动以埃塞俄比亚将军拉斯·阿卢拉·阿巴·内加命名，他出身提格雷。反攻于2021年6月11日发起，收复了提格雷中部和东部大片地区，包括地区首府默克莱。

zh.s: 2023年国际足联U-20世界杯决赛是该届世界杯的最后一场比赛，赛事由阿根廷主办。决赛于2023年6月11日在拉普拉塔的拉普拉塔球场举行，由意大利对阵乌拉圭。乌拉圭以1比0击败意大利，首次夺得U-20世界杯冠军。

en.s: The 2023 Russian Cup final (formally 'Superfinal' due to a new competition structure) was the 31st Russian Cup Final, the final match of the 2022–23 Russian Cup. It was played at Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow, Russia, on 11 June 2023, contested by CSKA Moscow and Krasnodar. It was the second consecutive Russian Cup Final at Luzhniki Stadium.

zh.s: 2023年俄罗斯杯决赛是2022–23赛季俄罗斯杯的最后一场比赛，也是该赛事第31场决赛。由于赛事赛制调整，这场决赛正式名称为“超级决赛”。比赛于2023年6月11日在俄罗斯莫斯科卢日尼基体育场举行，由莫斯科中央陆军对阵克拉斯诺达尔。这是卢日尼基体育场连续第二年举办俄罗斯杯决赛。

zh.t: 2023年伦斯特高级爱尔兰式曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2023年伦斯特高级爱尔兰式曲棍球锦标赛决赛于6月11日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，是该年度伦斯特高级爱尔兰式曲棍球锦标赛的决胜赛。卫冕冠军基尔肯尼对阵2022年伦斯特决赛选手戈尔韦。比赛由RTÉ2在《周日比赛》节目中直播，节目由乔安娜·坎特韦尔主持，安东尼·戴利、乔·坎宁和谢恩·道林担任评论嘉宾。

en.s: The 2024 Ohio's 6th congressional district special election was held on June 11, 2024, to fill the vacant seat in Ohio's 6th congressional district for the remainder of the 118th United States Congress. The seat became vacant on January 21, 2024, after Bill Johnson resigned to become president of Youngstown State University. The 6th district, largely rural in character with several smaller industrial cities, is considered a safe Republican seat.

zh.t: 2024年俄亥俄州第六国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2024年俄亥俄州第六国会选区特别选举于2024年6月11日举行，以填补美国第118届国会剩余任期内俄亥俄州第六选区的空缺席位。比尔·约翰逊于2024年1月21日辞职，转任扬斯敦州立大学校长，席位因此空缺。该选区以乡村地区为主，也包括数座较小的工业城市，通常被视为共和党稳固的选区。

en.s: On June 11, 2024, jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) attacked the town of Mansila and its military base, killing over a hundred Burkinabe soldiers. The attack weakened public perception of the Burkinabe junta and sparked tensions between the junta and disgruntled military officers.

en.s: The 2024 Las Vegas mayoral election took place on June 11, 2024, with a runoff on November 5, to elect the mayor of Las Vegas, Nevada. Incumbent independent mayor Carolyn Goodman was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a fourth term in office. This was the first mayoral election in Las Vegas since 1995 where no candidates were from the Goodman family.

zh.s: 2024年拉斯维加斯市长选举于2024年6月11日举行，第二轮投票定于11月5日，以选出内华达州拉斯维加斯市市长。时任无党派市长卡罗琳·古德曼已达任期限制，不能竞选第四个任期。这是自1995年以来，拉斯维加斯首次出现候选人中没有古德曼家族成员的市长选举。
